business_goal: Help facilities planners trace how buildings, installed equipment, and maintenance work orders relate so they can prioritize repairs and answer asset history questions.
organization_context: A facility-maintenance team manages buildings, installed assets, and corrective work orders across a campus.
decisions: Prioritize maintenance work by building and asset criticality.
Confirm which work orders affect a specific facility or equipment asset.
desired_outcomes: Connect facilities, equipment, and work orders with evidence-backed relationships.
Keep unsupported vendor-response questions visible for later source expansion.

competency_questions.question: Which facility contains a specified equipment asset?
Which equipment assets are installed in a facility?
Which equipment asset is addressed by a work order?
Which work orders affect equipment in a facility?
Which work orders have been recorded for an equipment asset?
Which vendor response-time commitment applies to an equipment asset?

safety_constraints: Do not initiate maintenance actions automatically.
